title: Video Downloader for Pinterest
summary: Download video, photo, GIF and image from Pinterest fast & easy, HD
description:
Video Downloader for Pinterest helps you quickly download high-quality videos, GIFs, and photos from Pinterest. Pinterest Saver is an easy-to-use app that helps you save Pinterest videos and photos to albums, enabling offline playback and sharing of ideas with your friends.
Features:
- No login required.
- Fast download speed.
- Safe & light & HD.
- Easy to use with a simple and clear interface.
- Support multiple formats: video, photo, gif, and image.
- See file sizes of quality options and decide easily which you want to download from Pinterest.
How to save videos from Pinterest? Method 1
1. Open the Pinterest app, click on the share icon.
2. Click this Pinterest downloader app icon on the opened popup.
3. Click the download button to the quality you want to save with this Pinterest Downloader.
4. Done! Your video will be downloaded automatically.
Method 2
1. Open the Pinterest app, click on the share icon and click "Copy Link".
2. Open the Pinterest video download app and click the save icon to the quality you want.
3. If you don't see download options popup, then paste the link and click Pinterest video download. Then apply step 2.
4. Done! Your video will be downloaded automatically.
Where are the videos stored? All videos saved from the app will be stored in a folder under the name Pinterest Downloader.
